claim: ChronoCTI uses language models to recover the order of techniques from report text.
quote: We propose a large language model-based machine learning pipeline named ChronoCTI to mine temporal patterns from CTI reports.
issue: The order is temporal relations among ATT&CK-mapped actions: "the temporal relations between malicious actions denote the order between the actions in terms of time" (p. 8945 printed, PDF p. 5). The "language models" are RoBERTa-class classifiers; Rahman reports that ChatGPT and Gemini did worse (Sect. 5.5). That fits the sentence. Published KIS 2025 copy quoted.
